There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.

translations.web: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
translations.bsb: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
translations.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
translations.asv: The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.
